```{r}
library("mapview")
library("tidyverse")

locations <- read.csv("C:/Users/matil/OneDrive/Desktop/Aguillon Lab/Gary + LSU Scorings.xlsx - M&F.csv")

red.prop.dorsal <- read.csv("C:/Users/matil/OneDrive/Desktop/dorsal recolorize/updated.dorsal.red.prop.df.csv")

dorsal.cline.df <- as.data.frame(cbind(red.prop.dorsal$samples..AS.THEY.APPEAR.IN.MASTER.GOOGLE.SHEETS., red.prop.dorsal$red.prop, locations$LONG_DEC, locations$LAT_DEC, locations$CORRECT_NUMERIC_SITES))
colnames(dorsal.cline.df) <- c("ID NUMBER", "PROP.RED", "LONGITUDE", "LATITUDE", "SITES")
dorsal.cline.df <- dorsal.cline.df[!is.na(dorsal.cline.df$LONGITUDE), ]
dorsal.cline.df <- dorsal.cline.df[!is.na(dorsal.cline.df$PROP.RED), ]

dorsal.cline.df$SITES <- as.numeric(dorsal.cline.df$SITES)
dorsal.cline.df$PROP.RED <- as.numeric(dorsal.cline.df$PROP.RED)
dorsal.cline.df$LONGITUDE <- as.numeric(dorsal.cline.df$LONGITUDE)
dorsal.cline.df$LATITUDE <- as.numeric(dorsal.cline.df$LATITUDE)

cline_summary <- dorsal.cline.df |>
  group_by(SITES)|>
  summarize(samples = n(),
            red.prop_mean = mean(PROP.RED),
            red.prop_se = sd(PROP.RED/12)/samples,
            long_mean = mean(LONGITUDE),
            lat_mean = mean(LATITUDE)) |>
  arrange(SITES)

cline_summary


mapview(cline_summary, xcol = "long_mean", ycol = "lat_mean", col.regions = c("white"), crs = 4269, grid = FALSE)

```
